card.name: Linking words before a brand or company name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, for, the, like, from or an opening parenthesis, right before a named product, drug brand or company. Seen in transplant drug dosing text and in tech-hardware text.

modes.label: Before drug brand names
modes.description: A linking word or parenthesis comes just before a transplant drug name such as THYMOGLOBULIN, NULOJIX or cyclosporine.
modes.example: The recommended dosage<< of>> THYMOGLOBULIN for

modes.label: Before tech companies or chips
modes.description: A linking word comes before a chip maker or chip product name such as Intel.
modes.example: The first commercially available DRAM chip was<< the>> Intel 1103, introduced

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors words starting with qual and the word Texas.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words right before a specific brand or company name is about to appear.
